queries.sql: SELECT "t0"."id" AS "todoID", json_array_length("t0"."checklist") AS "itemCount", ("t0"."checklist" ->> '$[0].title') AS "firstItemTitle" FROM "Todo" AS "t0" WHERE ("t0"."listID" == :listID) ORDER BY "t0"."position" ASC

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."listID" AS "listID", "t0"."title" AS "title", "t0"."notes" AS "notes", "t0"."dueAt" AS "dueAt", "t0"."priority" AS "priority", "t0"."isCompleted" AS "isCompleted", "t0"."position" AS "position", "t0"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "t0"."checklist" AS "checklist" FROM "Todo" AS "t0" WHERE (((("t0"."listID" == :listID) AND (("t0"."isCompleted" == :includesCompleted) OR ("t0"."isCompleted" != :includesActive))) AND ((:overdueOnly == 0) OR (("t0"."dueAt" < :referenceDate) AND ("t0"."isCompleted" == 0)))) AND (("t0"."title" REGEXP :searchPattern) OR ("t0"."notes" REGEXP :searchPattern))) ORDER BY IIF((:sortOrder == 1), COALESCE("t0"."dueAt", '2100-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), '2100-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') ASC, IIF((:sortOrder == 2), "t0"."priority", 0) DESC, IIF((:sortOrder == 0), "t0"."position", 0) ASC, "t0"."title" ASC
SELECT "t0"."listID" AS "listID", COALESCE(SUM((CASE WHEN ("t0"."isCompleted" == 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), 0) AS "openCount", COUNT(*) AS "totalCount" FROM "Todo" AS "t0" GROUP BY "t0"."listID"
SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."name" AS "name" FROM "Tag" AS "t0" ORDER BY "t0"."name" ASC

SELECT "t1"."todoID" AS "todoID", "t2"."id" AS "tagID", "t2"."name" AS "tagName" FROM "TodoTag" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "Todo" AS "t0" ON ("t0"."id" == "t1"."todoID") INNER JOIN "Tag" AS "t2" ON ("t2"."id" == "t1"."tagID") WHERE ("t0"."listID" == :listID) ORDER BY "t2"."name" ASC

SELECT "t0"."todoID" AS "todoID", "t1"."id" AS "tagID", "t1"."name" AS "tagName" FROM "TodoTag" AS "t0" INNER JOIN "Tag" AS "t1" ON ("t1"."id" == "t0"."tagID") WHERE ("t0"."todoID" == :todoID) ORDER BY "t1"."name" ASC

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."listID" AS "listID", "t0"."title" AS "title", "t0"."notes" AS "notes", "t0"."dueAt" AS "dueAt", "t0"."priority" AS "priority", "t0"."isCompleted" AS "isCompleted", "t0"."position" AS "position", "t0"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "t0"."checklist" AS "checklist" FROM "Todo" AS "t0" WHERE ("t0"."id" == :id)
SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."name" AS "name", "t0"."position" AS "position", "t0"."createdAt" AS "createdAt" FROM "TodoList" AS "t0" WHERE ("t0"."id" == :id)
SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."name" AS "name", "t0"."position" AS "position", "t0"."createdAt" AS "createdAt" FROM "TodoList" AS "t0" ORDER BY "t0"."position" ASC, "t0"."name" ASC

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."listID" AS "listID", "t0"."title" AS "title", "t0"."notes" AS "notes", "t0"."dueAt" AS "dueAt", "t0"."priority" AS "priority", "t0"."isCompleted" AS "isCompleted", "t0"."position" AS "position", "t0"."createdAt" AS "createdAt", "t0"."checklist" AS "checklist" FROM "Todo" AS "t0" ORDER BY "t0"."createdAt" ASC, "t0"."position" ASC
